note: Computed at build time from RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 intersected with Natural Earth 50m country polygons. Both layers reprojected to EPSG:6933 (equal-area) before any area arithmetic. Shares are percentages of each entity's own land area, so a sum below 100 means part of the polygon carries no ecoregion; that gap is reported, never rescaled.
